MPLR.scope: RETAINED mandatory original requirement; this opinion closes none.

MPLR.retainedDispositionRow: | 009 work/fees/reserves | Original local/cumulative observations and explicit reserve data; global enforcement/native/resource/closure rules remain OD4/OD6. |

ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD1: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify exact source/domain admission rules for `Sequence::plan` and `FrameBindings`, including state/duty alias injectivity, schema compatibility, and which local duty registry identities may be projected (especially discharge-only incoming duties and awaiting actions subject to R7 `stage::decode::canonical_boundary`).
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD2: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify any new sequence/manifest/prefix identity, canonical digest preimage, origin verification, and persistent parent/reopen rules beyond the existing verbatim `program_hash` and `plan_hash` fields.
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD3: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify `SequenceError` variants, exact public error wire format, diagnostic precedence, failure publication/exit behavior, and how earlier observations and `StageRejection` attempted/committed counters are retained on failure.
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD4: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify global `LogicalAllocation` preflight and enforcement, rejected/false-guard/late-call charges, checked arithmetic overflow handling, plan/invocation/output size bounds, adapter overhead metering, and `closure_reserve` consumption authority.
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD5: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify participant, source, and intent authority and obligation-formation consent semantics (`MPLR-008`, `MPLR-019`) without introducing project-membership whitelists.
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD6: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify transaction phase/head/ledger semantics, including behavior when successor `Q` fails after predecessor `P` completes, recovery/rollback vs. compensation (`MPLR-005`), and native `Step`/ledger correspondence.
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD7: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify private witness isolation, persistent cross-process continuation handoff, and authenticated asynchronous event origin, correlation, finality, and single-consumption rules (`MPLR-002`, `MPLR-006`, `MPLR-013`).
ownerDependenciesVerbatimFromOpinion.OD8: Mandatory designated-owner contract required before implementation: specify rules and boundaries for the remaining composition operators—shared-state interleaving (`SI1–SI4`), atomic synchronization (`Join` and atomic domains), disjoint parallel extensions, and asynchronous branches/late duties (`MPLR-007`).
